pages.title: Right click a monster
pages.text: Costs 1 coin:$(li)50% $(thing)Stun$() for 5 seconds - movement and navigation frozen$(li)50% $(thing)infighting$() - nearby mobs of the same kind start fighting (16 blocks)$(br2)Chance and radius are configurable.

pages.title: Right click a villager
pages.text: Trade 1 coin for a $(thing)permanent 20% discount$().$(br2)Wandering traders accept it too.
